# Dangerous-pattern rules, one per line: <extended regex><TAB><description>[<TAB><flags>]
# Blank lines and lines starting with '#' are ignored.
# flags: 'i' matches case-insensitively. Use it for ssh_config and gitconfig
# keys, which those tools read case-insensitively, never for shell commands.
curl[^|]*\|[[:space:]]*(sudo([[:space:]]+-[^[:space:]]+)*[[:space:]]+)?(bash|sh|zsh|dash)([[:space:]]|$)	remote script piped directly into a shell — fetch, verify, then execute instead
wget[^|]*\|[[:space:]]*(sudo([[:space:]]+-[^[:space:]]+)*[[:space:]]+)?(bash|sh|zsh|dash)([[:space:]]|$)	remote script piped directly into a shell — fetch, verify, then execute instead
chmod[[:space:]]+(-R[[:space:]]+)?0?777([[:space:]]|$)	world-writable permissions
chmod[[:space:]]+(-R[[:space:]]+)?a\+w([[:space:]]|$)	world-writable permissions
bash[[:space:]]+<\([[:space:]]*(curl|wget)	remote script run via process substitution — fetch, verify, then execute instead
sh[[:space:]]+-c[[:space:]]+"\$\((curl|wget|fetch)	remote script run via command substitution — fetch, verify, then execute instead
(curl|wget)[^|]*\|[[:space:]]*env[[:space:]]+[^|]*[[:space:]](ba)?sh([[:space:]]|$)	remote script piped into a shell via env — fetch, verify, then execute instead
--allow-unsigned-rpm	package signature check disabled
--nogpgcheck	package signature check disabled
--gpg-auto-import-keys	repository signing keys trusted without verification
curl[^|;&]*[[:space:]](-[a-zA-Z]*k[a-zA-Z]*|--insecure)([[:space:]]|$)	TLS certificate verification disabled
wget[^|;&]*[[:space:]]--no-check-certificate([[:space:]=]|$)	TLS certificate verification disabled
StrictHostKeyChecking[= ]+no	SSH host key verification disabled	i
^[[:space:]]*(ProxyCommand|LocalCommand|KnownHostsCommand)([[:space:]]|=)	ssh_config directive that runs a command — review before shipping	i
^[[:space:]]*PermitLocalCommand([[:space:]]|=)+yes	ssh_config LocalCommand execution enabled	i
^[[:space:]]*Match[[:space:]]+(.*[[:space:]])?exec[[:space:]]	ssh_config Match exec runs a command on every connection	i
^[[:space:]]*(fsmonitor|sshCommand|hooksPath)[[:space:]]*=	gitconfig directive that runs a command or redirects hooks — review before shipping	i
^[[:space:]]*helper[[:space:]]*=[[:space:]]*!	gitconfig credential helper runs a shell command — review before shipping	i
^[[:space:]]*(clean|smudge|process)[[:space:]]*=	gitconfig filter runs a command on checkout/commit — review before shipping	i
